CRM notes (shorthand):
- Product team: 5 PMs/10 engs active; primary stakeholder = Head of Product (Lina Gomez).
- Use-case: internal knowledge base + support assistant for mid-market SMB customers; latency sensitive for chat (target p95 < 300ms for short replies).
- Cost sensitivity: wants to cap token spend; evaluating committed capacity to get predictable pricing.
- Models: prefer open model family (Llama/GPT-J variants) for on-prem / dedicated; will accept Redwood-curated variants if throughput beats self-hosting.
- Security: must meet SOC2 + SSO (SAML) + audit logs visible in console; retention controls for 90/180 day retention + adhoc deletion APIs. Data residency for EU customers (some customer records reside in eu-1 region).
- Network: strict VPC peering, no public egress for traffic to inference GPUs; need diagram + CIDR ranges to hand to networking team.
- Legal: requires SOC2 Type II report and summary of encryption at rest and in transit; wants KMS integration details (customer-managed keys ideal).
- Quote: asked for 3-tier pricing: hosted POC credits, dedicated reserved quarterly commit (min $75k/yr), optional private deployment if needed for enterprise customers.
- "Their words": "We like the performance in the demo — but we need to be able to point to compliance docs before procurement."
- Internal red flags: procurement wants clear rollback/fallback plan if dedicated region experiences outage; request for automatic fallback to hosted (but with data path restrictions).
- Notes on SE ask: provide canary rollout steps, model rollback runbook, and token-cost projection templates.
- Next follow: security sign-off (3/18), draft MSA + commitment pricing (Jordan to send by 3/16).
